[Backport 5.x] fix(validation): lowercase header names in propertyNames enum/const (#7104)

Backport of 35c32375731c111439682b2f9e6e0baed2694269 to `5.x`.

- Lowercase header names in `propertyNames` `enum`/`const` in headers
schemas
- Document that regex header-name constraints are not case-normalized
- Add `FSTSEC003` warning when a `$ref` is used inside `propertyNames`
in a headers schema

The only conflict was in `lib/warnings.js`: `5.x` also has `FSTWRN004`
and `FSTDEP022`–`FSTDEP025`, so both sets are kept.
